Company: BKNG
Jan research (many sources; citations and numbers checked by code against each source):
- Booking Holdings turns 34.41% of revenue into operating profit, compared to Airbnb's 21.01%. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/booking-bkng-vs-airbnb-abnb-213151041.html] (2026-10-04)
- Booking produced $7.73 billion of levered free cash flow against Airbnb's $3.21 billion. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/booking-bkng-vs-airbnb-abnb-213151041.html] (2026-10-04)
- Booking Holdings Inc. (BKNG) closed at $159.02 on October 2, and Airbnb, Inc. (ABNB) at $162.43. The two share prices are almost identical. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/booking-bkng-vs-airbnb-abnb-213151041.html] (2026-10-02)
- Meta's Muse shopping agent reached 560,000 daily active users within 11 days [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Truist cut price targets on Booking Holdings from $242 to $216 and Expedia Group from $309 to $288 [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings' consumer direct mix held in the mid-60% range for four quarters [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Only about 10% of Booking Holdings' room nights come from top global hotel brands [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings processes payment on approximately 73% of gross bookings [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings reported revenue of $7.35 billion [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings' Transformation Program savings target about $650 million by end of 2027 [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Expedia Group posted 14% revenue growth and raised guidance [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings CFO Ewout Steenbergen states AI hyperscalers don't know their ROI, but internal AI use has improved cost per booking and customer satisfaction. [https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/booking-holdings-cfo-says-even-144243300.html] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings (BKNG) topped earnings estimates by 3.67% in the last reported quarter, with earnings of $2.54 per share vs. Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2.45 per share. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-booking-holdings-bkng-poised-151005804.html] (2026-10-01)
- Booking Holdings has an Earnings ESP of +0.35%, indicating analysts' growing bullishness on its near-term earnings potential. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-booking-holdings-bkng-poised-151005804.html] (2026-10-01)
- Zacks research shows stocks with positive Earnings ESP and Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) or better beat consensus estimates 70% of the time. [https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-booking-holdings-bkng-poised-151005804.html] (2026-10-01)
- Meta's Muse AI agent can shop for users and check out on their behalf, but the transaction layer is not Meta's. [https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/01/how-booking-holdings-and-expedia-are-taking-opposite-bets-on-ai-shopping-agents/] (2026-10-01)
- Benzinga reports Truist Securities lowered Booking Holdings' price target from $242 to $216, maintaining a Buy rating. [https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BKNG/price-targets] (2026-09-30)
- Booking Holdings continues to deliver robust earnings and free cash flow growth, outpacing booking volumes despite industry-wide travel slowdowns. [https://seekingalpha.com/article/4950965-booking-holdings-stock-meta-muse-not-break-9-percent-shareholder-yield] (2026-09-30)

Booking Earns More on Every Dollar:
